label: GOD_4 HAS_WILL_1 through an inclination following an apprehended good (inference)
rule: Choose one actualizing intelligible form presenting good and use it in both inclination steps
meaning: For each GOD_4, use its intellect to obtain an actualizing intelligible form under which it apprehends a good. The restricted inclination law supplies an orientation following that very form in that same bearer. The guarded recognition premise gives HAS_WILL_1 for that bearer. The conclusion is possession of will. Any act, rational giving or possible withholding requires further hypotheses.
